payload.name: pc-contrast-11
payload.description: Pure-logic validator for raw records. Returns {ok, records} where records is the original list only if every item is a non-empty object with exactly the string field 'code' (length 2..5) and an exact-boolean 'enabled'; otherwise records is []. Empty list is invalid. No exceptions, coercion, I/O, imports or host calls; no upstream validation assumption.
